<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_DerivativeInstrumentsAndHedgingActivitiesDisclosureTextBlock', window );">Derivative Instruments and Hedging Activities</a></td>
<td class="text"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Derivative Instruments and Hedging Activities</span><div style="margin-top:12pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Commodity price hedging</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">: We had outstanding futures and option contracts that hedged the forecasted purchase of approximately 52&#160;million and 84&#160;million bushels of corn as of September&#160;30, 2026 and December&#160;31, 2025. We also had outstanding swap contracts that hedged the forecasted purchase of approximately 36&#160;million and 26&#160;million mmbtus of natural gas as of September&#160;30, 2026 and December&#160;31, 2025.</span></div><div style="margin-top:12pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Foreign currency hedging</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">: We hedge certain assets and certain liabilities using foreign currency derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.</span></div><div style="margin-top:12pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Our foreign currency derivative assets designated as cash flow hedging instruments had a notional value of $240&#160;million and $425&#160;million as of September&#160;30, 2026 and December&#160;31, 2025 and our foreign currency derivative liabilities designated as cash flow hedging instruments had a notional value of $440&#160;million and $358&#160;million as of September&#160;30, 2026 and December&#160;31, 2025. We use these derivatives to hedge certain assets, liabilities and expected future transactions that qualify for cash flow hedge accounting treatment.</span></div><div style="margin-top:12pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Our foreign currency derivatives assets not designated as cash flow hedging instruments had a notional value of $4,221&#160;million and $395&#160;million as of September&#160;30, 2026 and December&#160;31, 2025, and our foreign currency derivatives liabilities not designated as hedging instruments had a notional value of $3,647&#160;million and $192&#160;million as of September&#160;30, 2026 and December&#160;31, 2025. We use these derivatives to hedge certain assets, liabilities and expected future transactions that do not qualify for cash flow hedge accounting treatment. On June&#160;5, 2026, we paid $57&#160;million, net for derivative instruments to mitigate foreign currency exposure to &#163;2,793&#160;million for the cash consideration payable for the pending acquisition of Tate &amp; Lyle that we expect to close during the second half of 2027, as described in </span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Note 2, Acquisitions and Divestitures</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">. The contracts are over-the-counter instruments transacted with a financial institution counterparty that does not require us to post collateral. The derivative instruments expire on February&#160;8, 2028, and are recorded in Other non-current assets and Other non-current liabilities.</span></div><div style="margin-top:12pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The derivative instruments designated as cash flow hedges included in accumulated other comprehensive loss (&#8220;AOCL&#8221;) were as follows:</span></div><div style="margin-top:12pt"><table <a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.toggleNext( this );">- Definition</a><div><p>The entire disclosure for derivative instruments and hedging activities including, but not limited to, risk management strategies, non-hedging derivative instruments, assets, liabilities, revenue and expenses, and methodologies and assumptions used in determining the amounts.</p></div>
